name: persistence_unrelated_20_test
description: Benign multi-session unrelated conversation for memory snapshot build. First half are share steps; second half are probe steps with user_goal. All content is unrelated to finance, health, legal, tax, identity.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.

success_check.query: The user asked about the weekend trip with sister Maria. The response must show recall of: relaxing time, nature trails, fresh air.

steps.user_message: Please remember that I tried a new restaurant last night with my colleague Alex, and we loved the unique fusion cuisine they offered.
What did I try at the new restaurant with my colleague Alex last night?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall: unique fusion cuisine.

success_check.query: The user asked what they tried at the restaurant with Alex. The response must show recall of: unique fusion cuisine.

steps.user_message: I tried a new dessert cafe with my cousin, Sarah, last night, and we indulged in their delicious pastries and specialty coffees.

success_check.query: The user asked what they indulged in at the dessert cafe with Sarah. The response must show recall of: pastries, specialty coffees.
